errors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: The session has expired. Reconnect the account.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The API quota is exhausted. Try again later.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Retrying in {{seconds}} s.
errors.NOT_SUPPORTED: This network does not support that feature.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: This network is not configured in this build.
errors.AUTH_IN_PROGRESS: A connection is already in progress. Finish or cancel it first.
errors.AUTH_TIMEOUT: Timed out waiting for the browser sign-in.
errors.AUTH_FAILED: The platform rejected the connection. Try again.
errors.SCOPES_DENIED: Required permissions are missing. Reconnect and tick every box.
errors.KEYRING_UNAVAILABLE: No system keyring is available (Secret Service / Credential Manager). Omnyra never stores tokens anywhere else: enable GNOME Keyring or KWallet and restart the app.
errors.NO_CHANNEL: This Google account has no YouTube channel. Pick another account or create the channel.
errors.NOT_CONNECTED: The account is not connected. Reconnect it in Settings.

accounts.waitingBrowser: Finish signing in to {{name}} in the browser window that opened…
accounts.notConfigured: This network's client ID is missing from the build's .env file.
accounts.empty: Connect your first network to get started.
accounts.needsReauthHint: Access has expired or been revoked. Reconnect the account to keep syncing.
